welcome:
Welcome to the Pulumi CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated infrastructure-as-code environment.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: Create a new Pulumi project using the AWS TypeScript template.
Preview the infrastructure changes before deploying.
Check the stack outputs to get resource endpoints.
View all configuration values for this stack.
Export the current stack state for backup.
Check which Pulumi plugins are installed.
View detailed environment and project info.
List all available stacks in this project.
Set a secret configuration value for the database password.
steps.hint: Try: pulumi config set --secret dbPassword S3cur3P@ss!

steps.instruction: Verify the secret was stored (value should be encrypted).
Refresh the stack state to detect any drift from actual cloud resources.
Import an existing S3 bucket that was created outside Pulumi.
steps.hint: Try: pulumi import aws:s3/bucket:Bucket legacy-data legacy-data-bucket-prod

steps.instruction: List all stacks again to confirm the current stack.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  pulumi new [template]          — Create a new Pulumi project
  pulumi preview                 — Preview infrastructure changes
  pulumi up                      — Deploy infrastructure changes
  pulumi destroy                 — Tear down all resources
  pulumi stack [subcommand]      — Manage stacks (ls, select, init, rm, output, export, import)
  pulumi config [subcommand]     — Manage configuration (set, get, ls, set --secret)
  pulumi refresh                 — Reconcile state with actual cloud resources
  pulumi import                  — Import existing cloud resources
  pulumi state delete            — Remove a resource from state
  pulumi cancel                  — Cancel a running update
  pulumi whoami                  — Show current identity
  pulumi version                 — Show CLI version
  pulumi login                   — Log in to Pulumi backend
  pulumi logout                  — Log out from backend
  pulumi plugin ls               — List installed plugins
  pulumi plugin install          — Install a plugin
  pulumi about                   — Show environment info
  pulumi watch                   — Watch for file changes and auto-deploy
  pulumi logs                    — Show resource logs

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help
